steps: Draw 3.0 mL bacteriostatic water with a sterile 3 mL syringe.
Inject slowly down the vial wall to avoid foaming.
Gently swirl or roll the vial until fully dissolved (do not shake).
Label with date and time; refrigerate at 2–8 °C (35.6–46.4 °F) , protected from light.
For optimal potency, use reconstituted solution promptly or within a few days [9] .

protocols.name: Male Fertility Protocol
protocols.frequency: Frequency: Inject three times per week subcutaneously (for example, Monday, Wednesday, and Friday) [3] [4] . HMG therapy is typically combined with hCG injections to maximize testosterone production and spermatogenesis [5] [6] .

references.description: hMG composition: 1:1 blend of FSH and LH derived from postmenopausal urine; standard preparations provide 75 IU FSH + 75 IU LH per vial
Human menopausal gonadotropin for subcutaneous administration; each vial contains 75 IU FSH + 75 IU LH activity

references.citation: ASRM Practice Committee 2020 – Gonadotropin Use for Ovulation Induction
references.description: Clinical guidance on gonadotropin therapy; low-dose protocols (37.5–75 IU) with careful monitoring

references.citation: ASRM Patient Fact Sheet – Medications for Inducing Ovulation
references.description: Typical gonadotropin protocols: 75–150 IU injected daily for approximately 7–12 days; course may extend if ovaries respond slowly

references.citation: Metrovan Urology – Hormones and Male Infertility Treatment
references.description: In hypogonadal men, hMG added at 75–150 IU three times weekly if hCG alone insufficient for spermatogenesis

references.citation: Metrovan Urology – Combined hCG and hMG Therapy
references.description: hCG given 2–3 times weekly stimulates testosterone; hMG provides FSH activity to stimulate sperm production when FSH deficient

references.citation: International Journal of Reproductive BioMedicine (Iran JRM, 2014)
references.description: Randomized trial: HMG 75 IU subcutaneously three times weekly for 3 months significantly improved sperm motility and morphology; pregnancy rate 57% vs. control
Subcutaneous administration for follicular stimulation; each 75 IU vial typically reconstituted in 1 mL diluent for 75 IU/mL concentration
Lyophilized menotropin stable at room temperature (15–25 °C) away from light; reconstituted solution should be used immediately to ensure potency and sterility
Use short, thin needle for SC injections; insert at 90° angle into pinched fatty tissue (45° if limited subcutaneous fat); do not reuse needles
Maintain skin health by alternating injection sites at least one inch apart; avoid areas with irritation, scars, or bruises

references.citation: Reproductive Medicine and Biology (2018) – Gonadotropin Therapy for Male Infertility
references.description: Review of hCG and hMG combination therapy for hypogonadotropic hypogonadism; FSH supplementation critical for spermatogenesis when hCG monotherapy inadequate
